Agent Name: WebSurfer
Step Number: 4
Reason for Mistake: Step 4 is the entry point of the loop where the WebSurfer incorrectly assumes all articles have .ps versions without verifying the actual page content, leading to a systematic data fabrication. This initial misinterpretation creates an irreversible error path, as subsequent steps (5-21) merely propagate this flawed assumption rather than correcting it, ultimately resulting in a wrong final count.
